liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): The jam features the best pre-verse playing of any version of the song; The jam feels tight and organized, condensing European exploration into high energy [10][15][17]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The performance is described as being as good as the song gets [13]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): The performance is typically strong for this era and well jammed [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-07-18.127703.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 217 min; rated 5/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.theotherwayne.88658.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 242 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Set two tunes prominently reflect flaws from the master tape reel decay [2]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.miller.32878.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 215 min; rated 4.55/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: Many tracks still contain static and buzzing originating from the piano [4]
- **gd72-07-18.aud.weiner.5916.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 178 min; rated 3.9/5 by 10 [5]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.lai.3348.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 183 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- Bob Dylan was backstage, marking his first appearance at a Dead show [9]
- The band played three sets, a rarity, and returned the next day [9]
- The reviewer expresses heartbreak over the loss of shared music archives [11]
- This was likely the largest crowd the band had played to that point [15]
- The reviewer revisits a dim memory of attending the show at age fifteen [16]
- The audience recording is considered superior to the soundboard due to room excitement [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-07-18.127703.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> Cool Edit Pro… [1]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.theotherwayne.88658.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by theotherwayne; source: SMR>?>DAT>WAV>CDR>SHN [2]. Also: Master tapes suffered reel decay; flaws were spliced back using Samplitude software [2]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.miller.32878.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [4]
- **gd72-07-18.aud.weiner.5916.sbefail.shnf**: source: Audience [5]. Also: Show information is embedded within the header of each flac file [19]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.lai.3348.shnf**: source: sdb>>master reel>>reel>>pcm>>cdr [7]. Also: The third set and encore are missing from this specific recording [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by visionsofdylan.blogspot.com: [7-18-72 Roosevelt Stadium 50th Anniversary](https://visionsofdylan.blogspot.com/2022/07/7-18-72-roosevelt-stadium-50th.html) [21]
